chain.label: Upper-left tail boom attachment bolt separated (cause undetermined), redistributing load and initiating progressive fatigue fracture growth in the remaining attachment fittings until the tail boom fully separated from the fuselage
chain.trigger: The upper-left tail boom attachment bolt separated first, resulting in the redistribution of the load normally carried by the upper-left attachment fitting to the remaining three attachment fittings and the subsequent initiation of fatigue fractures on the lower-left attachment fitting

chain.label: Uncontrolled spin following inflight tail boom separation
chain.trigger: about 30 minutes into the flight, the helicopter began an uncontrolled spin to the right ... following an inflight separation of the tail boom

caused_by.evidence: the tail boom came to rest about 762 ft northeast from the main wreckage, consistent with an inflight separation

chain.label: Helicopter descended while spinning uncontrollably and impacted terrain
chain.trigger: The helicopter continued to spin uncontrollably while it descended and impacted an area of rough, uneven, lava-covered terrain

caused_by.evidence: The helicopter continued to spin uncontrollably while it descended and impacted an area of rough, uneven, lava-covered terrain

chain.label: Serious and minor injuries to occupants
chain.trigger: The pilot and two passengers sustained serious injuries, and three passengers sustained minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: The pilot and two passengers sustained serious injuries, and three passengers sustained minor injuries
